children: Shilpa Samant New Delhi: The High Price Day-Ahead Market (HP-DAM) on the Indian Energy Exchange has rallied, often touching the maximum ceiling of 20 per unit through much of September, as sustained electricity demand, particularly during non-solar hours, has increased pressure supply. IEX data for September 6-17 shows the HP-DAM daily market clearing price reaching the 20 per unit ceiling during the period, with most trade in time blocks of non-solar hours, alongside a sharp rise in purchase bids.

title: Price on IEX Soars on High Power Demand
